title: E0 · Sprint 0 — Setup & spec rulings
body:
Founder-owned decisions and account/registration work Sprint 1 consumes (implementation-plan §2). All of it fits one week alongside E1 design docs.

**Exit:** all Sprint-0 decisions recorded; Sprint 1 starts unblocked; partner onboarding schedule agreed with the five clients.

title: E1 · Platform substrate — Cell-0
body:
The data plane's skeleton, shaped per D6/D7 from day one, sized per 'cheap on capacity' (INF-001). Zonal GKE + gVisor + namespaces + Neon fleet N=1 + reconciler agent + metering skeleton.

**Exit:** spike ADR recorded; `terraform apply` from empty → working cell; first tenant DB created/branched/destroyed by hand; metering events from a test pod. (implementation-plan §5 E1)

title: E2 · Identity, access & the cross-cutting spine
body:
Users, sessions, personal tokens (reveal-once), orgs/members/invites, RBAC two-layer evaluator, policy hook, events/audit ledger, problem+json framework. Everything else depends on this epic.

**Exit:** QA scenarios 6 (token reveal) & 8 (invite lifecycle) automated and green; table-driven test over the full RBAC matrix. (implementation-plan §5 E2)

title: E3 · Projects, environments, estimates, Postgres provisioning
body:
Estimate-before-provision made real: estimate engine (one arithmetic, ADR-025), service CRUD gated on `estimate_id`, Neon tenant/timeline provisioning via the reconciler, secrets, bindings (incl. bind-to-external-host), metering emitters.

**Exit:** `steloit db create` → estimate → `--yes` → ready end-to-end on cell-0; canon arithmetic invariants imported and green. (implementation-plan §5 E3)

title: E4 · Deploy & branched previews
body:
The wedge's flagship: push → build → deploy; PR → preview env with a branched (masked) database; rollback <60s; deploy markers. Custom domains & TLS (T4.8) follow in V1 Sprint 9.

**Exit:** push → estimate → approve → live service + Postgres → PR → preview URL with branched DB → merge → teardown (= milestone M4). (implementation-plan §5 E4)

title: E5 · CLI v0 (+ TS SDK, docs)
body:
Alpha is CLI-first (D11). Thin client of the same API — no CLI-only capabilities. Safety grammar: estimate shown before `--yes`, `--confirm <exact-name>`, no `--force`. V1 adds TS SDK v0 + docs.

**Exit:** every alpha-path step executable by CLI alone; full-loop asciinema recorded for partner onboarding. (implementation-plan §5 E5)

title: E6 · Baseline observe + metering pipeline
body:
Only what the alpha path and D10 demand: metrics/logs query APIs, metering store + rollups, hardened events SSE. The observability *product* is E10.

**Exit:** per-env metrics/logs queryable (SSE tail); per-org monthly usage report producible. (implementation-plan §5 E6)

title: E7 · Auth hardening & org surface completion
body: MFA (TOTP+WebAuthn), recovery codes, session list/revoke, password-reset emails, org API keys with scopes, invite emails + renew/decline (S3 fixes), leave-org/account-delete grace windows. Closes ADR-draft 7.4 so the console's A/P planes integrate without the seam. (implementation-plan §5 E7)

title: E8 · Console integration (MSW → real API)
body:
Swap MSW → real API surface-by-surface behind a per-family flag. Canon mode is retained permanently as the demo world (ADR-026) and E2E fixture harness. Each slice = flag flip + Playwright suite green.

**Exit:** session seam removed; all slices live; four-state truth verified per slice via fault injection. (implementation-plan §5 E8)

title: E9 · Data layer completion — Valkey, Object storage, Queue
body: Per GOV-002 v0.5: Valkey (per-project-env pods, D5), object storage (proxied GCS, D4; Steloit content-domain URLs, A1.4/A2.4), queue (A3.1 WAL-signal design review FIRST — scale-to-zero must survive; NATS is last resort). Postgres is the pioneer; these instantiate the same anatomy. (implementation-plan §5 E9)

title: E10 · Observability product + notifications + emails
body: Alert rules + 7-day backtest (431ms canon fixture), quiet hours routing-only, the notifications family (S4 — the 8-surface gap), 12 transactional email templates on one skeleton, traces endpoints. (implementation-plan §5 E10)

title: E11 · Billing & subscription
body:
Metering already flows (E6); this epic prices, gates, and charges it. Plans gate capabilities never safety; soft quotas bill / hard fail loudly; dunning day 0/7/21/90; cancel ≠ delete; invoice grammar == estimate grammar (ADR-025).

**Exit:** M7 — first real payment clears (lifts D11 hiring freeze, triggers capacity knob-turns). (implementation-plan §5 E11)

title: E12 · Governance — policies, templates, dashboards
body: Policies CRUD + versioning + dry-run impact preview, enforcement wired into the E2 evaluator (tighten-only, closest-wins); templates (frozen copies, secrets never captured — ADR-021); dashboards (scope ⊥ visibility, prebuilt as generated views). (implementation-plan §5 E12)

title: E13 · AI plane (four laws)
body:
Last by design (Law 4: the platform is already whole). 8 read-only tools, id-only context envelopes + resolver, threads, insights, proposals. No auto-apply path exists in the API — architecture, not policy.

**Exit:** QA scenario 7 (AI disable) green; apply re-runs full two-layer RBAC. (implementation-plan §5 E13)

title: E14 · Data-plane depth
body: Shaped by the S2 ruling. Wave 1 (V1-tail): read-only surfaces — SQL exec/tables/pg_stat insights, key browse, messages, objects, backups/branches lists. Wave 2 (Future): destructive verbs, policy-gated + audited. Also carries remaining spec-change §2b/2c/2d endpoints by blocked-surface count. (implementation-plan §5 E14)

title: EQA · QA harness & test automation
body: QA is not a phase; each epic ships with its suite. This epic owns the shared harnesses: the 10 canonical scenarios (16-qa/qa.md), arithmetic invariants at three layers, contract tests, RBAC sweep, UI consistency CI, drills-as-tests, fault injection, billing time-travel. (implementation-plan §10)

title: EOPS · DevOps & platform operations
body: Operations work not owned by E1's build-out: control-plane CI/CD (signed, workload identity, zero static keys), cost guardrails, self-observability + founder alerting, asia-south1 partner-cell prep, abuse controls before open signup. (implementation-plan §11)
